name: C1

replace.acknowledgment: Return saved representation; preserve order; empty clears

validation.condition: invalid body shape or ids: non-array, unknown, duplicates, more than three

ui.loading: Fetch saved IDs and disable edits; failure is unavailable with retry, not empty success
ui.write: Disable writes while pending; update only from validated acknowledgment
ui.failure: Retain last acknowledged selection, show useful error and offer retry

persistence: In-memory for API process lifetime; refresh survives; restart persistence excluded
acceptance: remove last then refresh stays empty
